description: The set's `evs` field holds Stat Points. Stats at level 50 are `base + SP + 20` (HP `base + SP + 75`), then the nature applies. The validator rejects a set with 0 Stat Points under Serious (it suggests another neutral nature if that was intended). The caps (32 per stat, 66 in total) and all-31 IVs come from the engine only; no official source states them (format matrix U5).
